findings.summary: Math.max with spread syntax on the samples array will cause a RangeError (Maximum call stack size exceeded) during long runs with many samples.
findings.suggested_fix: Use reduce instead of spread, e.g., this.samples.reduce((max, s) => Math.max(max, s.gpu.usedVramMb), 0) for peak calculations.

findings.summary: The sampleIntervalMs property is hardcoded to 200 in computeTelemetryData() instead of using this.intervalMs.
findings.suggested_fix: Change sampleIntervalMs: 200 to sampleIntervalMs: this.intervalMs in both return objects.

findings.summary: Using [...this.samples].reverse().find() creates an unnecessary full copy of the samples array, degrading performance for large sample sets.
findings.suggested_fix: Locate the post_unload sample by iterating backwards with a for-loop or using Array.prototype.findLast().
